summary: Iteration 1. Backend: 27 pytest cases written and run against the public URL (auth/demo/forgot-reset, /me role switch, records CRUD for 7 kinds, caregiver permissions 403, network join/request/invite/accept/delete, signals and notifications, products, favorites, kits with size max, cart, checkout, orders, cancel, home, history). 26 of 27 pass; the failure is a 500 when cart qty is not a number. Frontend (390x844): these flows pass: landing -> welcome -> demo patient -> home; register a new patient through all 6 onboarding steps to home; Agenda FAB create event -> detail -> edit -> delete; patient sends a quick signal and the caregiver logs in and responds (status becomes Atendida); kit builder (6 steps, size limit enforced 4/4) -> save -> kit detail -> cart -> checkout (validation errors shown, Express shipping) -> order confirmation AM-xxxxx; catalog category chips, search empty state, product personalization (color, text, qty), favorites, cart detail; settings text size (11px -> 14.3px); network invite code, invite by email, invalid code message. CRITICAL: switching role from caregiver back to patient crashes the app to the ErrorBoundary screen. Deprecated packages detected: expo-router/unstable-native-tabs.

minor.issue: A non-numeric qty (e.g. 'abc') returns 500 (ValueError from int()) at server.py:729. Also: qty has no upper bound, ref_id is not checked against products/kits, and PUT /api/cart/{cid} qty has no upper bound.
kit_fields reads i['product_id'] directly, so an item without product_id gives 500 (KeyError) at server.py:651. Unknown product ids are saved and then silently dropped in kit_view.
No duplicate check, so the same email can be invited many times and each invite creates another pending link (server.py:327-338).
'signals' is not in DEFAULT_PERMS, so a patient cannot turn signal delivery off for a person (server.py:252 vs 477).

The raw dict body is stored without Pydantic validation. assignee_id can be any user id, which lets a caller send 'Te asignaron un pendiente' notifications to users outside their network (server.py:427-441).
Arbitrary profile/settings keys and onboarding_done values of any type are accepted without validation.
MOCKED: demo_code is returned in the response for any email. This must be removed once an email provider is added. Login has no rate limiting.

ui_bugs.issue: After switching caregiver -> patient, the app crashes to the ErrorBoundary screen: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)' at src/components/patient-home.tsx:56 (d.today_events.length). RCA: PatientHome (patient-home.tsx:29) and CaregiverHome (caregiver-home.tsx:17) both use useApi(`/home?today=${today}`) with the same cache key, so PatientHome renders the cached caregiver payload, which has no today_events. Patient -> caregiver works only because of the payload shape.

issues: The favorite state only changes the stroke color of a 16px outline heart (src/components/product-card.tsx:17), so favorited items are hard to tell apart (even on the Favorites screen). Use a filled heart. On product detail the favorite state is only a tiny badge dot.
The invite name/email, join code and request email inputs have no placeholders, so the empty boxes give no hint.
The 'Kit agregado al carrito' toast stays visible across two navigations (cart -> checkout -> order confirmation) and covers the header title.
The 'Marcar como resuelta' ghost button has no border or background, so it barely reads as a button.

react_native_issues.issue: A deprecated import produces a Metro warning: 'expo-router/unstable-native-tabs is deprecated. Use expo-router/native-tabs'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:4

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix the role-switch crash. Give the /home cache a role-specific key (e.g. `/home?today=${t}&role=${user.role}`) or invalidate/refetch /home on role switch, and guard PatientHome/CaregiverHome against the wrong payload shape (d?.role !== 'patient' -> loading; use optional chaining on today_events/upcoming/tasks).
Migrate the import in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:4 from 'expo-router/unstable-native-tabs' to 'expo-router/native-tabs'.
POST /api/cart: validate qty with Pydantic (int, 1..99), check that ref_id exists, and return 422 instead of 500.
Kits: validate items (product_id required and must exist) and return 422.
Network invite: return 409 for a duplicate pending/active invite to the same email; add 'signals' to DEFAULT_PERMS so it can be toggled.
Records: restrict assignee_id to the owner or caregivers with an active link; consider Pydantic models per kind.
Make the favorite state clearly visible (filled heart) on product cards and product detail; add placeholders to the Network inputs.
critical_code_review_comments: Several screens share the same useApi cache key while expecting different response shapes (/home). Any shared key needs a consistent payload or a role in the key.
Backend endpoints take raw dict bodies (records, kits, cart, /me, permissions) with no Pydantic validation, which leads to 500s on malformed input.
server.py is 917 lines (over 700). Split it into routers (auth, network, records, signals, shop, orders).

Order status is computed from created_at (advances every 3 min). That is acceptable for a demo, but cancel is checked against the computed status, so an order can only be cancelled within the first 6 minutes.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows pass except the caregiver->patient role switch, which crashes)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST users test_shop_ui@example.com / Test12345, test_ui_37731@example.com / Test12345 and several test_xxxxxxxx@example.com (pytest); there is no delete-user endpoint, so they remain. test_shop_ui has 1 kit, 1 order (AM-57942), a cart item, favorite p1 and a pending invite to test_invitee_ui@example.com. Test records, kits and links on the demo accounts were deleted by id. The 3 TEST signals sent from demo@amodo.app were deleted by id. Some notifications created by the tests remain on demo@amodo.app and acompanante@amodo.app.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (the test file falls back to it). pytest.ini uses xdist. In the web preview, Expo Router keeps hidden stacked screens in the DOM: use `:visible` or the testID-specific locator (e.g. [data-testid^=agenda-event-]) instead of get_by_text. Role switch: Perfil tab -> profile-switch-role-button:visible. To reproduce the crash: log in, switch to caregiver, then switch back to patient.
rca_of_issue: Role-switch crash: useApi caches by URL key. CaregiverHome and PatientHome both request `/home?today=YYYY-MM-DD`. When the role changes, the Home tab swaps components, but the cached data is the previous role's payload ({role:'caregiver', patients, signals...}). PatientHome then reads d.today_events.length, gets undefined, throws a TypeError and the ErrorBoundary takes over. Mitigation: add the role to the key or invalidate on switch, and add shape guards.
